summary: Data I/O Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a private placement, raising $9 million via 869,840 common shares, a $6.8254M convertible debenture (4% coupon, 5-year maturity, convertible into Series B Preferred at $1,000/share), and warrants for 1.08M common shares. The investors are Lytton-Kambara Foundation and Alice W. Lytton Family LLC. Proceeds serve as growth capital; automatic conversion triggers upon shareholder approval at the 2026 annual meeting. This is a structured capital raise, not a standard buyback or dividend. Watch dilution impact and conversion mechanics; no risk-arb angle unless conversion terms change.
